title: SMTP Service Extension for Secure SMTP over Transport Layer Security
summary: Describes the STARTTLS extension to SMTP, which lets a mail client and server upgrade a plain connection to one protected by TLS. This provides privacy and optional authentication against eavesdroppers. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Two mail programs start talking out loud, then agree to switch to a secret code so nobody listening can understand. This is how they ask each other to switch.

questions: how to encrypt smtp with tls
